name: io.blockmetric/mcp
title: Blockmetric
description: Read-only crypto market data: Hyperliquid liquidation heatmaps, liquidations, whales, funding, flow.

tools.name: get_liquidation_heatmap
tools.description: Where liquidations WOULD happen for one coin: the liquidation heatmap over time built from real tracked Hyperliquid positions. Returns the largest clusters of liquidatable positions above the mark (shorts) and below it (longs) in the newest snapshot, with USD at risk and the distance from the mark. Use it for "where are the liquidation levels / magnets for BTC?". For liquidations that already happened use get_liquidations.

coin.description: Coin name as on Hyperliquid, e.g. BTC, ETH, kPEPE, xyz:TSLA (case-insensitive).

hours.description: Look-back window in hours (default 24; capped by the plan's heatmap history: no key 24 h, a free key 30 days; the answer says when it was cut).

tf.description: Column interval (default: chosen from hours: 15m up to 7 days, 1h up to 30 days, then 4h, 12h and 1d). Every key opens 5m to 1d within its plan history; without a key 5m, 15m and 1h over 24 hours; 1m needs Desk or API Pro (plan_required).

end.description: End of the window (default now). Set it to look at the heatmap of an earlier time.

tools.name: get_liquidation_map
tools.description: Current liquidation levels of one coin from tracked Hyperliquid positions: USD of long and short positions per price bucket right now, with totals. A snapshot; for the history over time use get_liquidation_heatmap.

coin.description: Coin name as on Hyperliquid, e.g. BTC, ETH, kPEPE, xyz:TSLA (case-insensitive).

tools.name: get_liquidations
tools.description: Liquidations that HAPPENED: totals of the last hours (long/short USD, per venue, top coins, largest single liquidation) plus the latest individual liquidations the data licence allows, optionally only large ones (min_usd) or one side. Use it for "how much got liquidated today?" or "latest big liquidations". Counts as two API requests (totals and the latest list).

hours.description: Window in hours (default 24; capped by the plan history: no key 24 h, a free key 30 days; the answer says when it was cut).

coin.description: Coin name as on Hyperliquid, e.g. BTC, ETH, kPEPE, xyz:TSLA (case-insensitive).

venue.description: Only this venue for the latest liquidations list.

side.description: Only liquidated longs or shorts in the latest list.

min_usd.description: Only liquidations of at least this many USD in the latest list.

limit.description: Number of latest liquidations (default 5, at most 50).

tools.name: get_whales
tools.description: Largest tracked Hyperliquid wallets with labels (and the label source), open notional, all-time PnL, largest position and its distance to liquidation. Use sort=near_liq for whales close to liquidation.

sort.description: size = open notional (default), pnl = all-time PnL, near_liq = closest to liquidation, liquidated = most liquidations.

coin.description: Coin name as on Hyperliquid, e.g. BTC, ETH, kPEPE, xyz:TSLA (case-insensitive).

labelled.description: Only wallets with a label from a cited source.

tools.name: get_wallet
tools.description: One tracked Hyperliquid wallet: account value, open positions with leverage and liquidation prices, totals and the latest position changes.

tools.name: get_funding
tools.description: Funding rates per coin across Hyperliquid and the exchanges the data licence allows (annualised, as fractions) and the spread between venues.

coin.description: Coin name as on Hyperliquid, e.g. BTC, ETH, kPEPE, xyz:TSLA (case-insensitive).

limit.description: Number of coins, by Hyperliquid open interest (default 10, at most 50).

tools.name: get_long_short
tools.description: Long/short positioning per coin: Hyperliquid from tracked positions (USD ratio) and the account ratios of the exchanges that are not withheld.

coin.description: Coin name as on Hyperliquid, e.g. BTC, ETH, kPEPE, xyz:TSLA (case-insensitive).

tools.name: list_coins
tools.description: The Hyperliquid coins with market data, largest open interest first: mark price, open interest and 24h volume in USD, funding (APR), maximum leverage and the number of tracked positions. Use it to find the exact coin name (BTC, kPEPE, xyz:TSLA) before calling another tool, or for the largest markets.

coin.description: Only this coin (case-insensitive), e.g. to check that a name exists.

limit.description: Number of coins, by open interest (default 25, at most 200).

tools.name: get_open_interest
tools.description: Open interest of one coin in USD: without hours the current value per venue (Hyperliquid and the exchanges the data licence allows) and the total; with hours its history on one venue over the window (first, last, change, high, low and the newest buckets). Use it for "is open interest rising on BTC?".

coin.description: Coin name as on Hyperliquid, e.g. BTC, ETH, kPEPE, xyz:TSLA (case-insensitive).

hours.description: History window in hours (optional; without it the current values per venue). Capped by the plan history (no key 24 h, a free key 30 days); the answer says when it was cut.

venue.description: Venue of the history (default hyperliquid). Only with hours.

tf.description: Bucket size of the history (default 5m up to 48 hours, else 1h). Only with hours.

tools.name: get_open_interest_by_exchange
tools.description: Open interest of one coin on every venue over time (hourly or daily buckets) with the total per bucket, and the current open interest and share of each venue. Use it for "on which exchange is BTC open interest growing?". Binance and Bybit reach back with each exchange’s open-interest history (in USDT).

coin.description: Coin name as on Hyperliquid, e.g. BTC, ETH, kPEPE, xyz:TSLA (case-insensitive).

limit.description: Number of buckets, newest first (default 24 for 1h, 30 for 1d). Capped by the plan history (no key 24 h, a free key 30 days); the answer says when it was cut.

tools.name: get_funding_heatmap
tools.description: Funding per UTC day of the largest coins of one venue (the funding heatmap), with the cumulative funding of each coin over the window: what a 1x long paid per dollar of position (negative = it received), and the same as an average annualised rate. Use it for "which coins paid the most funding this month?".

days.description: Window in UTC days up to today (default 30). Capped by the plan history (no key 24 h, a free key 30 days); the answer says when it was cut.

limit.description: Number of coins, largest open interest first (default 10, at most 30).

tools.name: get_events
tools.description: Risk radar events, newest first: whale moves, whales near liquidation, big liquidations, cascades, funding extremes and flips, open interest spikes, records, exploits/hacks, stablecoin depegs, TVL drops, exchange outflows. Use it for "what just happened?".

coin.description: Coin name as on Hyperliquid, e.g. BTC, ETH, kPEPE, xyz:TSLA (case-insensitive).

tools.name: get_candles
tools.description: OHLC price candles of one coin (UTC-aligned) with volume: the price change, high and low over the window plus the newest candles. Use it for price context next to positioning or liquidation data. Optional: price oracle for the Hyperliquid oracle reference price (not a trade price), market spot for the trade candles of a Hyperliquid USDC spot pair.

coin.description: Coin name as on Hyperliquid, e.g. BTC, ETH, kPEPE, xyz:TSLA (case-insensitive). With market spot also a spot token name (UBTC, PURR) or a spot pair key (@142).

price.description: oracle = Hyperliquid oracle price candles of the perp market instead of the default series: a reference price, not a trade price, without volume. Not combinable with market spot.

market.description: perp (default) or spot = trade candles of the Hyperliquid spot pair quoted in USDC. A coin without such a pair answers not_found.

tools.name: get_screener
tools.description: Every coin in one table: price and open-interest change, funding now and predicted, long/short, liquidations in 24 h, nearest liquidation cluster, RSI and volatility. Sort to find movers, crowded trades or extreme funding.

coin.description: Coin name as on Hyperliquid, e.g. BTC, ETH, kPEPE, xyz:TSLA (case-insensitive).

min_oi_usd.description: Only coins with at least this open interest (USD).

tools.name: get_orderbook
tools.description: Order book liquidity of one coin: depth within bands around the mid (bids vs asks, imbalance) and the largest walls with their status (active, pulled before the price arrived, filled). Use it for support / resistance from resting orders.

coin.description: Coin name as on Hyperliquid, e.g. BTC, ETH, kPEPE, xyz:TSLA (case-insensitive).

venue.description: Only this venue (default every venue the licence allows).

tools.name: get_order_flow
tools.description: Taker flow of one coin over a window: buy vs sell volume, delta and cumulative volume delta in total, per venue, by print size and for tracked whales, plus the volume profile (point of control, value area). Use it for "who is buying BTC?".

coin.description: Coin name as on Hyperliquid, e.g. BTC, ETH, kPEPE, xyz:TSLA (case-insensitive).

hours.description: Window in hours (default 24; clamped to the order-flow history of the plan: free keys and no key 24; the answer says when it was cut).

tools.name: get_large_trades
tools.description: The newest large taker prints (trades above the tape threshold) with side, price, size and whether a tracked whale was the taker.

coin.description: Coin name as on Hyperliquid, e.g. BTC, ETH, kPEPE, xyz:TSLA (case-insensitive).

min_usd.description: Only prints of at least this many USD.

minutes.description: Look-back window in minutes (default 60; clamped to the order-flow history of the plan, the answer says when it was cut).

tools.name: get_movements
tools.description: Large on-chain transfers and whale moves, newest first: exchange in/outflows, transfers between wallets, stablecoin mints and burns, bridges, DEX swaps and large Hyperliquid positions and trades, with labels where a source names the wallet.

asset.description: Asset symbol, e.g. BTC, ETH, USDT.

min_usd.description: Only movements of at least this many USD.

labelled.description: Only movements with a labelled sender or receiver.

tools.name: get_traders
tools.description: Hyperliquid trader leaderboard: PnL and ROI per window, account value, observed win rate, drawdown, Sharpe and style tags. Use it to find consistently profitable wallets; follow up with get_wallet.

style.description: Only traders with this style tag (paid plans).

tools.name: get_smart_money
tools.description: What the most profitable tracked wallets do: convergence events (several top wallets opening the same side of a coin within a short window) and their current net positioning per coin.

coin.description: Coin name as on Hyperliquid, e.g. BTC, ETH, kPEPE, xyz:TSLA (case-insensitive).

limit.description: Number of events and coins (default 10, at most 50).

tools.name: get_security_incidents
tools.description: Hacks, exploits, depegs and other security incidents, newest first: detector events and curated incidents with the reported loss and primary-source links.

tools.name: get_listed_wallets
tools.description: Wallets a cited listing names (OFAC SDN list, FBI / IC3 announcements, incident post-mortems of the affected protocol), each as "Listed as <category> by <source>, <date>" with a link. With an address: its listings, balances and tracked on-chain movements (404 when it is not listed). The other side of a movement is never labelled by us.

address.description: One address (EVM, Bitcoin, Tron …): its listings and movements.

source.description: Only this source: ofac_sdn, fbi_ic3 or incident.

network.description: Only this address family (evm, bitcoin, tron …).

limit.description: Number of wallets or movements (default 10, at most 50).

tools.name: get_exchange_flows
tools.description: On-chain flows into and out of exchange wallets over a window: inflow, outflow and net per exchange and asset (stablecoins, BTC, ETH). Net outflows often mean coins moving to self-custody, inflows coins ready to sell.

asset.description: Only this asset family, e.g. USDT, BTC.

tools.name: get_my_limits
tools.description: The plan behind this server's key (or keyless access): requests per minute and per day and how many are left, the history window, heatmap intervals and whether commercial use is allowed. Use it before a large research task or when a tool reports a rate limit. Not counted against the limits.

tools.name: get_api_status
tools.description: Whether the Blockmetric API and its data feeds are healthy right now: overall status, API version, feeds that are delayed or down, and open incidents. Use it when data looks stale or a tool fails.
